stages.name: operator invariants and Wan-hook smoke
stages.research_question: Is the event/time routing operator mathematically correct and gradient-reachable?
stages.minimum_evidence: CPU toy tests plus actual Wan hooked forward identity and nonzero-adapter gradient check

stages.name: training-free counterfactual semantic control
stages.research_question: Can conditional velocity differences change the specified event at a chosen latent time?
stages.data: 4 prompt pairs x 1 video seed exploratory
stages.primary_evidence: complete paired MP4 human video judgement; solver replay exact

stages.name: visual evidence in original-prompt reconstruction
stages.research_question: Does masked original text recovery depend on the performed motion rather than the prompt prior?
stages.data: SSv2 research-licensed labeled short clips, source-separated train/validation; independently evaluate generated trajectories
stages.metric: paired correct-vs-counterfactual masked token log-odds, t x s noise map

stages.name: reconstruction semantic guidance
stages.research_question: Is the reconstruction energy gradient directed toward the desired video event?
stages.metric: final MP4 event behavior and local residual alignment, not text accuracy alone

stages.name: posttraining coupling and text loss ablation
stages.research_question: Does original-text reconstruction improve video beyond identical temporal adapter and its compute?
stages.primary_metric: paired event completion and event order human-verified

implementation_limits: Do not launch full joint pretrained video model or copy Uni-ViGU architecture before E1/E2 evidence
Do not treat latent-frame masks as pixel-frame boundaries
Do not treat a teacher-forced video probe as generated-trajectory evidence
Do not interpret decoded text accuracy as video improvement
Freeze evaluation before confirmatory runs; keep human-viewable paired MP4s
Discrete token resampling is not differentiable: use causal intervention or an explicit estimator instead of naive autograd through sampling
